t: Listen to an announcement on a university radio station.
Starting next Monday, the group study rooms on the third floor of Hartley Library will require a reservation.
You can book a room for up to two hours through the library's online system, and you'll need your student number to do it.
Rooms that are not claimed within fifteen minutes of the booking time will be released to other students.
The first-floor reading room will stay open on a walk-in basis, as always.
And a quick reminder: the library café now opens at seven, an hour earlier than before.
